summary: Smoke tested new auth, /shop, /account, legal pages, and admin regression. All backend auth endpoints and all frontend routes work. Two minor spec mismatches noted (see details): pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD (must use a real domain like example.com), and the shop testids in spec (shop-card-crystal-mirror-shop) reference the domain name instead of the actual product slugs — the implementation correctly uses real slugs (moon-crystal-24, obsidian-geode-2x3, rose-geode-oval, emerald-lagoon-round).
passed: POST /api/auth/login 200 on correct pw, 401 on wrong pw
POST /api/me/returns with order_number for non-owned order returns 404 'Order not found'
Signup flow via dialog closes dialog and Navbar shows first name (UI)
/shop renders 4 product cards with filter buttons (all/hero/companion)
/policies/{privacy,terms,refund,shipping} all render with correct h1 titles
Admin regression: /admin login with admin@artyfex.in loads dashboard (Revenue, Orders, Products, B2B Leads)

failed.issue: EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD emails (per spec 'collector-{random}@artyfex.test' fails with 422)
Spec expects data-testid='shop-card-crystal-mirror-shop' and 'shop-add-crystal-mirror-shop' but these do not exist. Implementation correctly uses per-product slugs: shop-card-moon-crystal-24, etc.
failed.evidence: Selector count=0 for spec ids; any_cards=4, any_adds=4 with real slugs. Likely a spec typo (used domain name instead of a real slug).

action_items: No blockers. Optional: if @artyfex.test signups must succeed, relax EmailStr to a simple regex or use pydantic 'check_deliverability=False'. Otherwise document that user emails should use real TLDs.
Optional: confirm spec's shop-card-crystal-mirror-shop was a typo — no code change needed.
